context_conditioning.coding_features: control flow, loop nesting, recursion, call graph, data dependency, indexed data, differential testing
context_conditioning.coding_remediation: V7 namespaced coding transition + primitive-presence priors
context_conditioning.features: abstract reasoning family, semantic domain, structural counts and flags

seed_training.training_data: mechanically verified formal arithmetic, algebra, Boolean logic, graph theory, partial orders, Horn inference, CSP search, and provenance; generated instances encode real formal semantics and no arbitrary labels
seed_training.v3_logic_sources: formal curricula patterned after theorem-prover rule reasoning and inductive relational benchmarks; all generated instances are independently recomputed from explicit logical semantics
seed_training.v4_acceptance_rule: accept only if old v3 logic shadow stays within 0.15 percentage points of baseline and coding validation improves; select best passing checkpoint
seed_training.v4_coding_oracle: generated bounded Python programs executed under a restricted AST/builtin whitelist; dataflow/callgraph/debugging answers recomputed independently from program structure or differential execution
seed_training.v5_acceptance_rule: accept only checkpoints that improve math validation while preserving V4 logic within 0.15 percentage points and coding within 0.30 percentage points; new math shadow remains unconsulted until checkpoint selection
seed_training.v5_math_oracle: exact rational arithmetic, SymPy symbolic algebra/calculus/trigonometry/geometry, and exhaustive or closed-form probability/statistics verification; generated examples encode genuine mathematical rules rather than arbitrary labels
seed_training.v6_acceptance_rule: accept only if mixed validation improves and accepted V5 logic, coding and math regression suites remain within tight tolerances; mixed shadow remains untouched until selection
seed_training.v6_oracle: exact program traces, bounded model enumeration, exact rational probability, algebraic closed forms, invariant checking and exhaustive bounded search
seed_training.v7_acceptance_rule: must improve rich coding validation and old V4 coding shadow by >8 points; both dataflow and straight-line validation >=80%; logic/math/mixed scores exactly preserved; rich shadow sealed until checkpoint selection
seed_training.v7_oracle: restricted executable Python for state traces, structural dependency/call graph analysis, differential execution for debugging; no answer-label training
